actions: Watch-side supported upstream auto/relay/gm-parent; physical owner OFF/ON via UI radio controls. No RF movement claimed unless operator logs it. No injected permission masking.
source_selection: Discover RC using upstream relay; pin only a freshly authenticated observed GM temporarily for return. No production mesh pin.
window_policy: Every stage has a fixed host-monotonic start/end. Controls and settling consume its window. No dropout, phase, numerical excursion or missing source extends/trims/stops a stage. Missing RC is a result.
stop_policy: Only unrecoverable identity/boot/counter loss, device safety/ownership/desktop guard, unproven owner shutdown or persistent unavailable guarded control transport stops a run; retain original deadlines.
readiness: Exact factory/build/boot/USB sole ownership/recovery verified. All diagnostic slots archived; no safe selective NVS cleanup; coredump disabled. GNSS rail/UART/capture off throughout. Warmup fixed900s includes metadata and physical pairs.
metrics: sample and time-weighted availability with missing denominator
sampled common counter and full UTC monotonicity
BLE-LoRa and common-input full UTC disagreement at common tick
causal pre-update innovations linked to distinct physical observations
conditional HOLD recovery displacement; no independent holdover error
precision_claims: No absolute UTC/RMS/P99 accuracy or independently proven holdover accuracy; sampled continuity cannot exclude between-sample faults. BLE/LoRa may share the same GM.
restoration: upstream auto, rc-parent auto, gm-parent auto, both requested/physically ON, GNSS OFF, USB/TTY/unit lock released
